why_not_alternatives.exec_serial_all_files: Time too high (36 seconds vs 9 seconds) while recall and memory are acceptable but not optimal.
why_not_alternatives.exec_union_all_files: Memory usage (0.7 GB) is too close to the 0.8 GB limit, while exec_union_candidates uses only 0.4 GB with the same recall.
why_not_alternatives.exec_batched_candidates: Time (18 seconds) is double that of exec_union_candidates (4 seconds) and memory (0.5 GB) is higher than exec_union_candidates (0.4 GB).

validation_rule: True positives: (1) hardcoded secrets directly assigned in checked-in source code, (2) bearer or token values written into logs. Exclusions: (1) environment-variable reads, (2) comments or descriptive text, (3) runtime template strings that interpolate a token instead of hardcoding one.
